title: Best Vacuums: Robot, Cordless & Pet Hair (2026)
summary: The guide highlights the Shark Stratos as the top pick for most buyers, followed by the Bissell Pet Hair Eraser, Mova P10 Pro Ultra, Shark PowerDetect Cordless, and Eureka QuickShift OmniVerse.
method: Products were selected from Good Housekeeping, CNET, Consumer Reports, ShouldIt, and TechGearLab reviews. Picks were ranked by the number of sources that mentioned them and by the strength of their stated features.
assumptions: Prices are not included because none of the sources provide them.

products.desc: The Shark Stratos is an upright vacuum that offers powerful suction, a HEPA filter, and a brush roll that resists hair tangles. It is designed for use on carpets, hardwood, and other floor types.
products.benefit: Picture a family with pets and mixed flooring. The Shark Stratos cleans carpets, hardwood, and pet hair efficiently, thanks to its HEPA filter and anti‑tangle brush roll.
